headlines.title: Lakers controlling owner Jeanie Buss hasn’t agreed to sell share of team, lawyer says
headlines.description: Her lawyer also accused Joey and Jesse Buss of leaking “false, defamatory and pernicious ‘information.’”

headlines.title: Oil jumps past $91 as Trump casts doubt on a new deal with Iran
headlines.description: The president said the critical Strait of Hormuz was “open,” but the latest shipping traffic data didn’t appear to support his claim.

headlines.title: Canada races to avoid new U.S. tariffs of up to 50%
headlines.description: The duties would hit a wide swath of goods, including hockey sticks, building materials, clothing and dairy products.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.

headlines.title: Is it Ok to Max Out Your Credit Card As Long as You Pay it?
headlines.description: There are many misconceptions about credit card payments, balances and credit scores, so NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY to set the record straight. She delves into whether cancelling a credit card impacts your score, if carrying a balance helps you build credit, and more.

headlines.title: Why Mid-August Is the Perfect Time to Book a Group Trip
headlines.description: The end of summer is a great time to squeeze in one more trip with family and friends, as prices tend to drop mid-August. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY with tips, including ways to split expenses, sorting out responsibilities among the group and more.

headlines.title: Why Shoppers Are Ditching Cooking for the Prepared Food Aisle
headlines.description: Demand for quick and easy meals is growing, with shoppers citing cost and convenience. Now major grocery chains including Whole Foods, Walmart, Sprouts and more, are beefing up their ready-to-eat food options. NBC's Vicky Nguyen reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Lakers to be sold to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12 billion
headlines.description: The Los Angeles Lakers are being sold to an ownership group led by Josh Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger reportedly for a $12.5 billion. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports on the new ownership group buying the franchise that had just been bought in late 2025.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Map: See how gas prices have changed in the county where you live
headlines.description: How much gas prices have increased during the Iran war depends entirely on where you live, an NBC News analysis of average gas price data from AAA shows.

headlines.title: Stocks rise and interest rates slide after inflation report
headlines.description: The S&P 500 and Russell 2000 stock indexes closed at record highs as concerns about a Fed rate hike eased.

headlines.title: Los Angeles Lakers sold to Bob Iger, Josh Kushner for $12 billion
headlines.description: The Lakers were previously sold to businessman Mark Walter in October at a valuation of about $10 billion.
